name: BRAINVISION to mne/raw
summary: Converts EEG data in BrainVision format (.vhdr/.vmrk/.eeg) to an MNE raw .fif file with MNE-Python read_raw_brainvision.
description: Reads the BrainVision header with mne.io.read_raw_brainvision and saves the recording as MNE raw.fif. Use it to bring BrainVision EEG recordings into the brainlife MNE pipeline. BIDS sidecars (channels, electrodes, coordsystem, events) are mapped but not used by the code.

inputs.description: EEG recording in BrainVision format; the .vhdr header (with its .vmrk and .eeg files) is read.

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
